events.title: Srebrenica Massacre Begins
events.description: Bosnian Serb forces under General Ratko Mladić captured the UN-designated safe area of Srebrenica during the Bosnian War and began systematically killing Bosniak men and boys. More than 8,000 people were murdered over the following days.
events.significance: It was the worst mass killing in Europe since World War II and was later ruled a genocide by the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia and the International Court of Justice.

events.title: Burr-Hamilton Duel
events.description: Vice President Aaron Burr shot former Treasury Secretary Alexander Hamilton in a duel at Weehawken, New Jersey. Hamilton died the following day from his wound.
events.significance: The duel ended the life of one of America's Founding Fathers and the architect of its financial system, and it effectively destroyed Burr's political career.

events.title: Mikimoto Cultured Pearl Breakthrough
events.description: Kokichi Mikimoto produced the first cultured pearl on July 11, 1893, by successfully inducing oysters to form pearls in his Japanese pearl farm.
events.significance: His methods launched the cultured pearl industry, making pearls widely affordable and transforming the global jewelry market.

events.title: Total Solar Eclipse over Hawaii and Mexico
events.description: A total solar eclipse crossed Hawaii, Mexico, Central America and South America, lasting nearly seven minutes at its maximum, one of the longest of the 20th century.
events.significance: It drew thousands of astronomers and tourists and offered a rare opportunity for scientific observation of the solar corona.

events.title: Birth of John Quincy Adams
events.description: John Quincy Adams, the sixth President of the United States, was born in Braintree, Massachusetts, son of President John Adams.
events.significance: He became a leading diplomat, president from 1825 to 1829, and later a prominent anti-slavery congressman, shaping early American foreign policy including the Monroe Doctrine.
